full_page.content:
Page 230 Aug. 27 Shirley Ann Hillebrand - 11 - enemic and nephritis and abcessed ear - She takes her sickness remarkably in good grace ....
Michael Makowski - 42 - in Kiefer's - T.B. of lungs. Drs. say only hope operation whereby ribs and part of lung be removed. Wife (with three ... ) hesitate to - can't to such operation. Starts novena and reading of "City of God" - was enrolled last week.
Mrs. Mary Curran - 54 - heart trouble - her only son killed in ad- cident over a year ago. She has never recovered from shock.
Mary Syr in Windsor - must stay.
E'd James Salley - 37 - fearful cancer - given up two weeks ago as simply hopeless - seemingly pulling thru.
Warren Whitte - 28 - nerveous break. ... would like to study -
Cath. Donahue - 7 - seemingly hard of hearing speaks very few words and very inarticulate.
Mother Lillian - 40 - fears tuomer
29th
Dan Swavely - 35 - hurt playing foot-ball at 20. .. paralyzed & helpless.
Page 231 Sept. 4 Mrs. Mary Ann Gustafson - 25 - spleen and kidney trouble; has husband and baby almost 2 yrs. - Husband non C.
Dr. Stanley B. Waligora M.D. - 54 of Cicero - Chicago-25 yrs. in prac- ticing medicine - 13 yrs on crutches with arthritis. Enrolled July 9th when sister in law begged that Fr. S. go to Chicago. Fr. S. told her "impossible" then added "it will not be necessary. You tell Dr. to get on job and come to Detroit. He is here To-day - improved but still on crutches - not able to sit down. Deo Gr.
Robert Guyer - 17 - of(Cleveland Ave. ) Breckenridge, Pa. - plastic paralysis ever since birth ... Father Lutheran
Wm. B. Driscoll - 42 - of Posidina Calif. - severe asthma ....
Perry Leisen - 37 - Abereen, S.D. - paralysis - moving - has wife and 4 small children ... trys to sell insurence ....
Mary Ann Fitzgerald - 3 - high fever - Drs. at sea as to cause.
